mods.manifest:
{
  "schema": 1,
  "id": "RelicCore",
  "name": "Relic Core",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "author": "Relic Hunter",
  "description": "Runs the Relic Mods window and the shared parts every Relic mod uses. Shift+F7 opens and hides the window in game.",
  "groups": [
    { "id": "window", "label": "Relic Mods window" }
  ],
  "settings": [
    {
      "key": "AutoOpen",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "window",
      "label": "Open at the main menu",
      "default": true,
      "personal": true,
      "tooltip": "Shows this window when the game reaches the main menu. Shift+F7 always opens it."
    },
    {
      "key": "HideInWorld",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "window",
      "label": "Hide when a world loads",
      "default": true,
      "personal": true,
      "tooltip": "Tucks the window away when you load into a world, so the game gets your mouse and keyboard."
    },
    {
      "key": "LaunchWindow",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "window",
      "label": "Start the window with the game",
      "default": true,
      "personal": true,
      "restart": true,
      "tooltip": "Turn off to never start the Relic Mods window. Your Relic mods still use their saved settings."
    }
  ]
}

{
  "schema": 1,
  "id": "MagneticPickUp",
  "name": "Magnetic Pick-UP",
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "author": "Relic Hunter",
  "nexus": 934,
  "description": "Automatically picks up stones, sticks, herbs and other ground items near you, using the game's own pick-up.",
  "groups": [
    { "id": "pickup", "label": "Auto-pickup" },
    { "id": "speed", "label": "Speed" },
    { "id": "extra", "label": "Extras" }
  ],
  "settings": [
    {
      "key": "Enabled",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "pickup",
      "label": "Mod on",
      "default": true,
      "tooltip": "Turns the whole mod off without uninstalling it."
    },
    {
      "key": "AutoPickup",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "pickup",
      "label": "Auto-Pickup Ground Items",
      "default": true,
      "tooltip": "Picks up stones, sticks, herbs and other ground items near you. Same as the row in the game's Settings > Gameplay."
    },
    {
      "key": "PickupRadius",
      "type": "slider",
      "group": "pickup",
      "label": "Pick-up reach",
      "min": 1,
      "max": 10,
      "step": 0.5,
      "decimals": 1,
      "default": 3.5,
      "suffix": " m",
      "tooltip": "How close ground items must be. The game's own magnet reach is 3.5 m."
    },
    {
      "key": "PickEvery",
      "type": "slider",
      "group": "speed",
      "label": "Time between pick-ups",
      "min": 0.05,
      "max": 1,
      "step": 0.05,
      "decimals": 2,
      "default": 0.1,
      "suffix": " s",
      "tooltip": "Lower picks things up faster."
    },
    {
      "key": "ScanEvery",
      "type": "slider",
      "group": "speed",
      "label": "Time between looks around you",
      "min": 0.1,
      "max": 2,
      "step": 0.05,
      "decimals": 2,
      "default": 0.25,
      "suffix": " s",
      "tooltip": "How often the mod looks for ground items. Higher is lighter on your PC."
    },
    {
      "key": "SettingsRow",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "extra",
      "label": "Show the row in Settings > Gameplay",
      "default": true,
      "personal": true,
      "restart": true,
      "tooltip": "Adds Auto-Pickup Ground Items under the game's Auto-Magnetize rows."
    },
    {
      "key": "Verbose",
      "type": "toggle",
      "group": "extra",
      "label": "Detailed log",
      "default": false,
      "personal": true,
      "tooltip": "Writes a line to UE4SS.log for every pick-up."
    }
  ],
  "presets": {
    "Casual": { "AutoPickup": true, "PickupRadius": 5, "PickEvery": 0.05, "ScanEvery": 0.2 },
    "Balanced": { "AutoPickup": true, "PickupRadius": 3.5, "PickEvery": 0.1, "ScanEvery": 0.25 },
    "Hardcore": { "AutoPickup": false, "PickupRadius": 2, "PickEvery": 0.25, "ScanEvery": 0.5 }
  }
}
